data.name: Indi
data.gender_notes: Indi is used as a unisex name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Indi is recorded in name-lists as “God's Gift”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Indi expresses “God's Gift”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Indi total 27, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

in_hebrew.name: עִנְדִי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: עִנְדִי (Indi) - כִּכְלִי מֶלֶךְ יְהוָה, שְׂגִיא נְדִי, מֶלֶךְ יְהוָה עִמָּדִי, נַעֲרִיִּם עִמָּדִי, שְׂגִיא נְדִי.

in_greek.name: Ἰνδῖ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἰνδῖ (Indi) - Ἰνδῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς, βασιλεύς Κυρίου μου, ἀπάνθρωπος, ἄνθρωπος ὁ Ἰησοῦς.

in_latin.name: Indi
in_latin.long_meaning: Indi (Indi) - Filius Domini, indicium amoris, indicium gratiae, indicium spiritualitatis.
